title: 🔥 Limited DON!! card — Premium Bandai orders open (Oct 2–Nov 29)
body: Bandai opened made-to-order sales for the LUFFY 'Flame-Flame Fruit' DON!! card. Order window is 2 Oct–29 Nov 2026 (may close early); ships from April 2027.

announcement.news: Bandai's official site has opened made-to-order sales on Premium Bandai for the LUFFY 'Flame-Flame Fruit' DON!! Card, tied to the Flame-Flame Fruit Coliseum. The order window runs 2 October – 29 November 2026 — open to anyone 15+, no event attendance needed — but Bandai warns it can close early if demand is high. Shipping is planned from April 2027 onwards.
announcement.analysis: Made-to-order Premium Bandai items are produced to match demand, so they rarely 'sell out' the usual way — but the early-close warning and the long wait to April 2027 are the catches. This is a collector piece, not a quick flip (Bandai discourages buying for resale).
announcement.value: If you want the DON!! card for your collection, ordering inside the window is the safest way to get it at retail. Note it's a Premium Bandai (Japan) order, so collectors outside Japan may need a proxy/forwarding service — and it won't arrive until spring 2027.
announcement.deadline: Order window: 2 October – 29 November 2026 — but it may close earlier if capacity is reached.
announcement.risk: Premium Bandai is Japan-focused (overseas buyers may need a proxy), delivery is far out (April 2027+), and secondary-market value is uncertain. Bandai discourages buying for resale.

title: 🎪 BANDAI Card Games Fest hits Jakarta — Oct 10–11
body: The BANDAI Card Games Fest stops at Mall Alam Sutera (Tangerang) on 10–11 October, featuring the One Piece Card Game and limited commemorative products sold on-site while stock lasts.

announcement.news: BANDAI's Card Games Fest 26-27 world tour reaches Jakarta on 10–11 October 2026 at Mall Alam Sutera, Tangerang. It features the One Piece Card Game alongside limited commemorative products available to buy at the venue — items like official playmat & card sets and premium card collections typically sell on-site in limited quantities, while stock lasts.
announcement.analysis: It's one of the few official One Piece Card Game play-and-buy points in Indonesia, and limited fest-exclusive items tend to sell out quickly and reappear on the local secondary market at a premium.
announcement.value: If you can get to Mall Alam Sutera on those dates, the limited commemorative products are worth grabbing at the venue before stock runs out — fest exclusives often hold their value afterward. Go early; quantities are capped and first-come.
announcement.deadline: 10–11 October 2026 at Mall Alam Sutera, Tangerang — while venue stock lasts.
announcement.risk: The exact product lineup, pricing and stock aren't guaranteed and can change — confirm on Bandai's official event page before you go.

title: 🆕 EB-05 'Heroines Edition Vol.2' confirmed for late October 2026
body: EB-05 lands ~30–31 Oct 2026 — Nico Robin Leader, SP Nami & Robin, and five leader parallels. The first Heroines set is still sold out.

announcement.news: Bandai has confirmed EB-05 'Heroines Edition Vol.2' for around 30–31 October 2026 (Japan: ¥240 per 6-card pack; English: $4.99 per 12-card pack). Cards revealed so far include a Nico Robin Leader (Green/Yellow), SP versions of Nami and Robin, and leader parallels for Vivi, Shirahoshi, Hancock, Rebecca and Bonney. OP-18 'The Dominance of God' has also been announced, with an estimated ~November window.
announcement.analysis: The first Heroines set (EB-03) is still sold out, which points to strong, lasting demand for heroine cards. Japanese preorders and store lotteries usually open 3–5 weeks before release, so they could open any day now — allocation tends to matter more than the sticker price.
announcement.value: For collectors, the SP Nami and Robin and the leader parallels are the likely chase cards, and early copies at launch are usually the cheapest before hype builds. With EB-03 still sold out, sealed EB-05 could hold its value better than a typical Extra Booster.
announcement.deadline: Release around 30–31 October 2026. The preorder / lottery window has not been announced yet.
announcement.risk: The full card list isn't out yet, so the chase cards could disappoint. Extra Boosters are often reprinted, and a single-card-heavy set can mean softer demand for sealed product.
